name: Emdoor Information CO.,LTD.
summary: Emdoor Information CO.,LTD. provides electronic products and solutions in China and internationally. The company offers laptop tablet all-in-one; microcomputer host; reinforced laptops and tablets, handheld terminals, industrial control products, In-vehicle tablets; VR all-in-one MR products; and AR computing unit, smart speaker, smart sports equipment, AI glasses, and smart home central control platform. It serves life entertainment, business office, online education, logistics warehousing, industrial control, smart home, and many other fields. Emdoor Information CO.,LTD. was founded in 2002 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
